software_class: operational dashboard, admin panel, analytics, or business intelligence surface

options.name: Server-rendered admin interface
options.when_to_use: Operational workflows are form-heavy and need reliability.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when highly interactive analysis is central.
options.risks: Can become a CRUD panel without workflow design.

options.name: Interactive BI application
options.when_to_use: Users need slicing, drilldowns, and exploratory analysis.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when metrics are fixed and operational.
options.tradeoffs: Client complexity and data loading increase.

options.name: Embedded dashboard layer
options.when_to_use: Analytics must live inside an existing product surface.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when standalone operations are required.
options.rationale: Keeps context close to user workflow.
